company.name: Morphle Labs
company.shortDescription: Morphle Labs is a deep-tech healthcare automation company that develops robotic and imaging systems for cancer diagnostics.
company.description: Morphle Labs develops robotic and automated systems for cancer diagnostics, combining robotics, optics, and artificial intelligence to streamline pathology workflows. Its signature products include RoboTome, a robotic microtome that slices tissue biopsy blocks faster than manual methods, and MorphoLens, a high-throughput slide scanner that captures digital pathology images efficiently. The company also offers the Hemolens platform for scanning blood smears using AI to detect and sort cells. These systems integrate with laboratory information systems, support telepathology, and aim to reduce manual workload, improve throughput, and standardize diagnostics.
